title: Nonzero matrix image probability
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $D$ be a nonzero $n\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$. For a uniformly chosen vector $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the probability that $Dx\neq 0$ is at least $1/2$.
